findings.summary: Full fixture coverage is not established
findings.detail: Only 26 fixture cards were independently inspected; the CS2 facet reports 85. Difference: 59. A facet count is not an extracted pairing list. Do not invent the missing pairings or assume pagination mechanics without network evidence.

findings.summary: No official bookmaker prices confirmed in this audit
findings.detail: The fetched bwin competition page exposed a competition and market heading but no numerical event quotes. Polymarket is a prediction market, not a bookmaker. Existing third-party preview quotes and tournament outrights do not prove current match moneylines.

Hotspawn displays month/day and time without a timezone in the inspected lobby text. The inherited JSON appends Z. That UTC designation is unsupported by the lobby evidence. This audit leaves start_utc and start_timezone null; Polymarket rules independently state ET for the inspected direct markets.

The inherited JSON assigns FORZE Reload vs LFO 10 odds using related entries. The official market inspected is FORZE Reload vs Sökerorg, not LFO 10. No alias equivalence was established. Both fixture probabilities remain blank.

findings.summary: RoundsGG / Voca price is assigned to the wrong stored outcome
findings.detail: Inherited JSON row 25 stores 1.10 under team1=RoundsGG, while its note says that 1.10 belongs to Voca, team2. The official observed market lists Voca 1.10x91¢ and RoundsGG 2.13x47¢. Values remain suppressed because volume is zero and the paired prices are problematic.

findings.summary: Raw inverse odds are not normalized win probabilities
findings.detail: The inherited JSON contains 21 complete pairs whose displayed implied percentages differ from 100% by more than 0.2 percentage points. Raw 1/odds can legitimately include a spread/overround, but must not be mistaken for a coherent two-outcome forecast. Normalize only after verifying the exact moneyline and outcomes; arithmetic cannot repair wrong-market quotes. findings.summary: Stored outright no-vig arithmetic disagrees with its inputs
findings.detail: Recomputed denominator from the eight inherited decimal prices is 1.327256019. All 8 discrepancies are audit calculations from unverified repository inputs, NOT new verified bookmaker prices: [{"team": "Falcons", "stored_pct": 34.4, "recomputed_pct": 31.4}, {"team": "Legacy", "stored_pct": 21.7, "recomputed_pct": 19.8}, {"team": "FURIA", "stored_pct": 18.8, "recomputed_pct": 17.1}, {"team": "Aurora Gaming", "stored_pct": 13.1, "recomputed_pct": 12.0}, {"team": "BetBoom Team", "stored_pct": 6.9, "recomputed_pct": 6.3}, {"team": "9z Team", "stored_pct": 5.9, "recomputed_pct": 5.4}, {"team": "PARIVISION", "stored_pct": 5.5, "recomputed_pct": 5.0}, {"team": "Ninjas in Pyjamas", "stored_pct": 3.3, "recomputed_pct": 3.0}]. Outrights are not used for any match probability.

findings.summary: Rank-only model is reproducible, not calibrated
findings.detail: scripts/model.py maps HLTV ranks to artificial ratings with an arbitrary coefficient of 300 and an Elo denominator of 400. No fitted parameters, historical calibration, holdout evaluation, roster/map adjustment or uncertainty evidence is supplied. Its existing inputs mix dated rankings and undated team pages. This audit does not promote those derived percentages as validated win probabilities.

findings.summary: Source reachability is not numerical verification
findings.detail: A successful HTTP response can be an empty shell, challenge or unrelated market. The scheduled checks retain status, final URL, title, body hash and a warning, but never mark fixture or odds values verified. The published observation timestamp remains unchanged.

findings.summary: Historical snapshot; not a live odds feed
findings.detail: These observations were inspected on 2026-10-13T18:05:28Z. Source quotation timestamps, best bid/ask depth and quote executability were not confirmed. Four exact-name, directly inspected moneyline pairs support historical price-normalized calculations only. No guarantee of current prices or actual outcome accuracy.
